item.title: Master Asking for Referrals 🌐 • Identify the right person with relevant connections. • Use: "I admire your work and would value your referral." • Be clear about the position and why you're a fit. • Offer to provide your resume and job description. Who in your network could offer a valuable referral today? #networking #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
